title: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI Release Summary (2026)

blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per operating system (OS) for the Zscaler Client Connector for VDI on Zscaler Cloud & Branch Connector.

blocks.heading: November 06, 2026
Feature in Limited Availability: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.8.0.2 for Windows
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.8.0.2 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.text: Enables Zscaler Data Protection (ZDP) capabilities by leveraging DLP policies in multi-user Zscaler Client Connector for VDI environments.

blocks.heading: October 19, 2026
Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.19 for Windows
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.19 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.text: Fixes an issue where system traffic was not properly linked with user accounts in Private Access (ZPA) setups.

blocks.heading: September 11, 2026
Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.18 for Windows
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.18 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.text: Improves stability and fixes a deadlock issue that caused sessionListMutex timeouts.

blocks.heading: August 27, 2026
Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.17 for Windows
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.17 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Enhances initialization and shutdown resilience to prevent unexpected service terminations.
Fixes an issue where traffic was not properly linked with user accounts in Private Access setups.
Fixes multiple crash conditions to improve overall stability.

blocks.heading: Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.14 for Windows
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.14 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Fixes multiple vulnerabilities that allowed for local privilege escalation. (CVSS v3.1 Base Score: 7.3 - High)
Improves handling of non-default root CA certificates. (CVSS v3.1 Base Score: 8.9 - High)
Fixes an authentication bypass issue for Zscaler Client Connector. (CVSS v3.1 Base Score: 7.5 - High)
Fixes slow upload speeds for TCP traffic through the Cloud Connector tunnel.

blocks.heading: March 11, 2026
Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.10 for Windows
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.10 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.text: Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector for VDI added stray characters to the username field, causing the application to not start on some machines.

blocks.heading: Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.6.0.8 for Windows
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.6.0.8 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector for VDI failed to start due to a connection error.
Fixes removeRule failure issues during data channel reconnection.
Fixes a blue screen of death (BSOD) issue caused by the Windows Filtering Platform (WFP) driver.
Adds the global virtual IP (VIP) address in the mandatory TCP bypass rules.

blocks.heading: February 10, 2026
Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.7 for Windows
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.7 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.text: Fixes an issue that caused intermittent permission issues with WebView2.
